topic: Spark DataFrame, PyArrow, and NumPy BLAS Memory and Latency Benchmarks
problem_statement: Evaluate isolated runtime performance and driver memory usage across PySpark DataFrame partition scans, PyArrow columnar Parquet deserialization, and NumPy/BLAS batch matrix scoring on MovieLens 25M (24.67M ratings, 162,541 users, 58,932 items).
root_cause: Recommender systems require high-throughput Top-K scoring while operating within bounded driver RAM (16 GB machine, < 1.2 GB process budget). Spark ALS scoring without batching can cause OOM errors.
solution_or_decision: Designed isolated performance benchmarks. PyArrow achieved 38.2M rows/s (0.65s for 24.67M ratings, RSS 382.0 MB). NumPy BLAS matrix multiplication achieved 8,863.9 users/s at batch size 2,500 (282.04 ms latency, RSS 724.6 MB, safely within the 1.2 GB budget). PySpark DataFrame executed full partition scan count in 3.98s and groupBy aggregate in 1.82s.
evidence: PyArrow columnar read 24.67M ratings in 0.65s (38.25M rows/s, isolated RSS 382.0 MB). NumPy BLAS matrix multiplication achieved 8,863.9 users/s at batch size 2,500 (282.04 ms latency, isolated RSS 724.6 MB < 1,200 MB budget). PySpark DataFrame count completed in 3.98s and groupBy aggregate in 1.82s.
